title: Drunk Mom Crashes on I-4 Tampa - Florida Highway Patrol
description:
On October 31st, 2022 FHP responded to a vehicular collision on I-4 in Tampa, Florida. Suspects vehicle traveled off of the entrance ramp, crossed the interstate, then traveling into the grassy center median. Her car overturned twice, causing the driver to be ejected from the vehicle, which also had 3 children inside.  All three children appeared uninjured after the crash. 

Upon meeting the suspect the officer observed several signs of possible impairment such as: glassy eyes, slurred speech, inability to focus on a task and being unsteady on her feet. Officer began his investigation for a DUI and asked the suspect, to preform a Field Sobriety Test. Suspect refused to preform the Field Sobriety Test leading to her being taken into custody at approximately 5:20pm.

On arrival to jail suspect was asked if they would submit a test of her breath to which she refused. At 6:18pm at the jail she was informed of her Miranda Rights. At the jail she then stated she had a license in Washington that had been suspended and that she had been attempting to be issued a Florida Drivers License. She later was charged with DUI (driving under the influence) and Driving with a Suspended License.
